title: {{NAME}} and the Super Save
moral: You do not need powers to be a hero, just a brave heart.

pages.content: {{NAME}} loved two things. Soccer and superheroes. He kicked a ball against the wall every day. One afternoon the sky turned purple and sparkly. A flying figure came down fast. It crashed right into the soccer pitch.

pages.content: {{NAME}} ran to the figure. It was a superhero. She had a bright green cape and red boots. Her name was Captain Bolt. She sat up slowly. "My flying power is out of charge," she said. {{NAME}} smiled. He had an idea.

pages.content: Captain Bolt's power came back. Her boots started to glow. She rose up off the ground slowly. She picked {{NAME}} up gently and flew him up high. He could see the whole city below. It was the most amazing thing ever.
